Name: OBJ_C1_01
title: Get off the pier
description: The boat is gone, so the only way out of Port Halvern is through it.
hint: Walk inland. The gantry lights are the only thing still working.

Name: OBJ_C1_02
title: Answer the radio
description: Somebody is calling the port band and nobody else is left to pick it up.
hint: Key the handset on your vest. She can see your flashlight from across the river.

Name: OBJ_C1_03
title: Follow the blood trail
description: Search the pier head for the contact team and follow the drag marks inland.
hint: The crushed handset is under the gantry leg, next to what's left of whoever was carrying it.

Name: OBJ_C1_04
title: Shelter in the dock office
description: The blood trail ends at the dock office, and its lights are still on.
hint: Key the relay radio in there and I'll log you in. That's how you keep your place.

Name: OBJ_C1_05
title: Read the cargo manifests
description: Find out what was shipped into Yard C and who shipped it.
hint: The clerk's desk. Minus four degrees is a strange temperature for medical supplies.

Name: OBJ_C1_06
title: Play the security log
description: Scrub the overnight camera log on the dock office monitor and find out what happened in Yard C.
hint: The deck under the monitor still has the tape in it. Use the jog dial and go back to the small hours.

Name: OBJ_C1_07
title: Cross Warehouse 3
description: Reach the yard side of the port through Warehouse 3 without being swarmed.
hint: They hear better than they see. Keep the pallets between you and them and don't run on the grating.

Name: OBJ_C1_08
title: Find the contact team
description: Search the side rooms off the warehouse floor for Pruitt's people.
hint: There's a door off the main floor somebody barricaded from the inside. Fourteen casings in one corner.

Name: OBJ_C1_09
title: Find the crane fuse
description: The gantry supply panel is missing its cartridge fuse. The spare is kept in the break room.
hint: Electrical cabinet in the break room. Read the rota board while you're in there, you'll want it.

Name: OBJ_C1_10
title: Open the customs cage
description: Pruitt locked his team's gear case in the customs cage and set the keypad to something only someone who watched the tape would know.
hint: Four digits, and he scratched the sentence into the frame instead of the number. When it opened.

Name: OBJ_C1_11
title: Restore power to Yard C
description: Seat the fuse in the control house, then bring the three gantries up in the supervisor's shift order.
hint: Whoever's on shift comes up first, then round the clock. It's night, so start with Crane 3.

Name: OBJ_C1_12
title: Enter the container yard
description: The yard gate is open. Find container VGR-7718 in Stack 4.
hint: Ground tier, Stack 4. The one with the torn-out gate in front of it.

Name: OBJ_C1_13
title: Kill the Hookman
description: The night crane operator is between you and the only door out of this port.
hint: When the hook bites steel instead of you, he's stuck for a couple of seconds. Shoot the growth on his back.

Name: OBJ_C1_14
title: Search container VGR-7718
description: Look inside the thing that was opened at 02:14.
hint: Eleven cases in the racks and one of them is open. Read the clipboard on the wall.

Name: OBJ_C1_15
title: Open the cargo shutter
description: Use the key off the Hookman's chain on the sealed cargo shutter at the south end of the yard.
hint: He had the key the whole time and locked himself in with them instead.

Name: OBJ_C1_16
title: Take the boat to Saltmere
description: Cross the river mouth to the harbour radio station on Saltmere Point.
hint: The tender's inside the shutter. Watch the water on the way down, the dock floods at high tide.

Name: OBJ_C2_01
title: Get off the landing
description: Moor the skiff on the Quay Row slipway and get up into the town.
hint: Up the slipway, past the crab pots. Chapel Lane is the one going uphill.

Name: OBJ_C2_02
title: Cross to the fish market
description: Work along the kerbstones and doorways of the flooded street to the market hall at the top of the road.
hint: Stay on the stone. They can't reach you out of the deep part if you don't give them a reason.

Name: OBJ_C2_03
title: Search the market and the cold store
description: Find Calder's first hidden page in the hall, then lever the bay 3 roller door and take the lighthouse crank off the nail.
hint: Under the auctioneer's desk, and whatever bay 3 is, it isn't fish. Vigor paid for it in advance.

Name: OBJ_C2_04
title: Try for the radio station
description: Take the Saltmere Point jetty toward Mara's window and find out why she says not to.
hint: You can look at my light from the jetty. That's the whole of what you can do about it tonight.

Name: OBJ_C2_05
title: Find Calder's house
description: Move house to house along Chapel Lane, hiding from the Drowned, until you reach the doctor's front door.
hint: Chapel Lane, the one house with medical journals on the shelf instead of nets.

Name: OBJ_C2_06
title: Search the cellar
description: Go down into the flooded cellar for the rest of Calder's packet: two pages, her dictaphone and the hymn sheet.
hint: Behind the preserve jars. She wrapped it in oilcloth because she knew it would be a wet year.

Name: OBJ_C2_07
title: Reach the chapel
description: Get to the chapel at the top of Chapel Lane and check in with Mara from the vestry relay radio.
hint: Vestry's behind the chancel. Relay radio, supply locker, and thick enough walls to hear yourself think.

Name: OBJ_C2_08
title: Play the hymn on the organ
description: Work the pedal line of hymn 42 on the chapel organ to draw back the pipe shutter Calder hid the bell tower key behind.
hint: Pedals only, the manuals are swollen shut. Six of them, in the order the sheet writes them.

Name: OBJ_C2_09
title: Open the bell tower and take the wheel
description: Unlock the tower door, climb to the ringing chamber and cut the sluice gate wheel off the frame.
hint: It's chained up with the ringing gear. Somebody didn't want that gate closed in a hurry.

Name: OBJ_C2_10
title: Search the harbor master's hut
description: Take the flare gun from the forced locker and read the chart table and the log before going near the basin.
hint: Somebody already forced that locker and wrote on the card why. Read it before you go out on the dock.

Name: OBJ_C2_11
title: Close the sluice gate
description: Ship the wheel on the west wall capstan and get three full turns in between the Brine Maw's passes to drain the basin.
hint: One turn per pass is all it gives you. Break off and move the moment the wake turns.

Name: OBJ_C2_12
title: Kill the Brine Maw
description: With the basin down to mud, put flare rounds into the sac behind its jaw while it is beached and cannot turn.
hint: It doesn't like burning. Behind the jaw hinge, when the sac lights up.

Name: OBJ_C2_13
title: Collect all five of Calder's pages
description: Put the whole diary together: two from the chapel, one from the market, two from her cellar.
hint: Where she prayed, where she worked and where she slept. Her words, and she wasn't being clever.

Name: OBJ_C2_14
title: Cross to the lighthouse
description: Walk the drained causeway out along the mole to the lighthouse door.
hint: The water's gone, so the causeway's a road again. Check the service camera on the rail on your way out.

Name: OBJ_C2_15
title: Align the three mirrors
description: Fit the crank and set the lower, middle and upper mirrors on the keeper's three bearings so the beam gathers on the chart mark.
hint: There's no keyhole on that door, so the lock is the light. Lower, middle, upper, in that order.

Name: OBJ_C2_16
title: Go down the hidden stair
description: Open the service door behind the keeper's chart and take the stair down under the island.
hint: Air's coming up at you. That means there's a room down there, and rooms have doors.

Name: OBJ_C3_01
title: Follow the tunnel under the island
description: Wade the service tunnel from the lighthouse stair to the sealed bulkhead at its end.
hint: There's a door at the end with a company serial stamped on it. That's your way in.

Name: OBJ_C3_02
title: Search annex reception
description: Check in on the relay radio, stock up at the supply locker and read what the closure left behind.
hint: Sign-in sheet on the desk. The last name on it hasn't signed out.

Name: OBJ_C3_03
title: Get through the patient ward
description: Cross the ward corridor to the observation room door.
hint: They barricaded those doors from the inside. Whatever they were keeping out is in the corridor with you.

Name: OBJ_C3_04
title: Play the trial footage
description: Run all three reels on the observation room projector and learn how V-7 began.
hint: Two reels first, then the third one will load. Watch it to the end, the end is the part that matters.

Name: OBJ_C3_05
title: Find out what is using the lift
description: Something is bringing the crypt lift down. Get to the shaft.
hint: Counterweight's moving. That cage is coming down on purpose.

Name: OBJ_C3_06
title: Search the flooded stairwell
description: Take the Level B2 keycard from the technician's body on the half-landing.
hint: His torch is still on. Take the card, and give her a second.

Name: OBJ_C3_07
title: Open the B2 bulkhead
description: The keycard is good but the reader is dead. Get the bulkhead open.
hint: Somebody on maintenance wrote a whole page of complaints about this exact reader.

Name: OBJ_C3_08
title: Read the V-7 trial log
description: Search the B1 labs for Calder's thermal trial sheets and learn the strain's weakness.
hint: Sheet seven. Write the four stages down, we are going to need them long after tonight.

Name: OBJ_C3_09
title: Work out the security office code
description: Read the lab whiteboard and the note taped to its frame to get the four-digit keypad code.
hint: The chief wrote the hint himself, and he was proud of it. Read the top line of the board.

Name: OBJ_C3_10
title: Get the annex master key
description: Enter the security office with code 0703 and take the master key off the chief's board.
hint: Zero seven, zero three. And read the clearance sheet on his desk before you leave.

Name: OBJ_C3_11
title: Open the annex armory
description: Use the master key on the armory door and take what the chief left behind.
hint: There's a rifle behind that door, and the next hour is going to ask for one.

Name: OBJ_C3_12
title: Reach the coolant plant
description: Cross the flooded lower level to the valve gallery. The pumps have been off for months.
hint: Stay out of open water. There's a crawl under the pipe run if you keep low.

Name: OBJ_C3_13
title: Run the cooling chamber through the cold-shock ladder
description: Work the three valves in order so the chamber floods, chills and purges, and the cold vault interlock releases.
hint: Plus four, minus twelve, plus four, purge. Serve every hold and purge last.

Name: OBJ_C3_14
title: Recover Antidote Component A
description: Take component A off the carousel in the cold vault.
hint: Carousel two, position one. It dies if it warms up, so don't sit down with it.

Name: OBJ_C3_15
title: Survive the Warden
description: The plant doors have shut. Use the gas valves and blast doors to strip his back plate and burst the fuel line.
hint: Gas, door, spark, then shoot the line on his back while it's bare.

Name: OBJ_C3_16
title: Launch the raft
description: Take the collapsed tunnel into the sea cave, lower the maintenance raft and push off.
hint: I'll row. You take the bow and keep both hands for the gun.

Name: OBJ_C3_17
title: Kill the Undertow
description: Call Mara left and right through the rock pillars and shoot the eye every time it opens.
hint: It opens the eye before it swings. Shout the turn early, I need the stroke before the wave.

Name: OBJ_C3_18
title: Reach the mainland shore
description: Row out of the cave and land on the Marrow Bay shingle.
hint: Those are the city lights. Fewer than there should be.

Name: OBJ_C4_01
title: Get off the shore
description: Pull the raft above the tide line and climb the harbour wall into the city with Mara.
hint: Two of them in the surf line. Shallow water slows you more than it slows them.

Name: OBJ_C4_02
title: Work up Harbour Avenue
description: Move north through the stalled evacuation convoy toward the plaza, avoiding the Brute on patrol.
hint: The one in the stab vest was fit this morning. Go around it, not through it.

Name: OBJ_C4_03
title: Recover the body camera
description: Wade into the flooded underpass and take the body camera off Officer Ruiz's mount.
hint: She was shot, not bitten. Whatever she filmed, somebody wanted it to stop.

Name: OBJ_C4_04
title: Cross the plaza
description: Get past the abandoned checkpoint and its two Brutes using noise lures and cover.
hint: Give them somewhere else to be. Throw long, stay low, move while they are turning.

Name: OBJ_C4_05
title: Get inside the station
description: Reach the police station lobby and set Mara up on the watch desk radio.
hint: Steel door, one way in, and a radio desk with a roof repeater. This is where she stays.

Name: OBJ_C4_06
title: Play the body camera
description: Dock Ruiz's camera on the watch desk charger and watch both clips.
hint: Two clips on it. The second one is the useful one, she filmed herself hiding a key.

Name: OBJ_C4_07
title: Find the evidence room key
description: Work out which records drawer in the archive Ruiz dropped the evidence room key into.
hint: One drawer per officer, filed by surname. She said it herself: my drawer, my mess.

Name: OBJ_C4_08
title: Search the evidence room
description: Unlock the evidence room, take the sleeve of booking print cards, and find out how locker 17 opens.
hint: Locker 17 is court sealed. The intake sheet says the bolt only lets go from the CID desk.

Name: OBJ_C4_09
title: Release the sealed locker
description: Use the right booking print card on the PrintLock pad at Det. Sgt. Ferris's desk to drop the bolt on locker 17.
hint: The pad tells you what it will accept. Three cards, one of them matches on pattern and ridge count.

Name: OBJ_C4_10
title: Take the payments ledger
description: Go back down to the evidence room and open locker 17.
hint: Six transfers in the book. Ferris only cared about four of them, and so should you.

Name: OBJ_C4_11
title: Find Pruitt
description: Go down to the holding cells and find the two men Hale had booked with no record.
hint: The custody log has two men in with no names and no charges. Vans from the port come here.

Name: OBJ_C4_12
title: Open Hale's safe
description: Derive the four digit code from the ledger's cleared payments and open the safe in the chief's office.
hint: His diary says it is in the book if you already know what you are looking at. Not the dates.

Name: OBJ_C4_13
title: Follow Hale down
description: Get through the locker corridor and down the back stair to the flooded sub-level without being caught.
hint: Two Brutes in a corridor of lockers is not a fight you win with what you are carrying.

Name: OBJ_C4_14
title: Put Hale down
description: Kill the mutated Chief Hale in the flooded long store, using the floor conduit against him.
hint: Both panels together, and only while you are on the walkway. The cavity opens when his limbs pull back.

Name: OBJ_C4_15
title: Open the sewer door
description: Use the brass key from the safe on the maintenance door beneath the sump room and take the interceptor north.
hint: The works map says this pipe ties straight into their service level. Their pumps, their doors.

Name: OBJ_C4_16
title: Account for Whitlock
description: Open cell 2 and recover Sam Whitlock's tags and his scratched message for the record.
hint: Cell 2's hatch is already open. Somebody looked in and walked away.

Name: OBJ_C4_17
title: Search the crashed ambulance
description: Force the rear doors of the ambulance on Harbour Avenue for medical supplies and Ruiz's unsent letter.
hint: The doors are sprung, not locked. Prise them and it will be loud, so clear the street first.

Name: OBJ_C5_01
title: Reach the Vigor intake
description: Follow the storm sewer under Harbor Avenue to the grey intake hatch off the fourth culvert.
hint: Fourth culvert, grey hatch. Don't stand still in the water.

Name: OBJ_C5_02
title: Find out what the pumps are for
description: Cross the intake hall on the service level and read the dosing skid work order.
hint: Six skids and a locked timer. Whatever he's running, the paperwork is on the rail by skid three.

Name: OBJ_C5_03
title: Get into the tower
description: Take the service stair up to the lobby and reach the relay radio in the reception back office.
hint: Two of their security are standing at the shutters. Go low and go around.

Name: OBJ_C5_04
title: Read the staff board
description: Look at the research division photo behind reception and tell Mara what is in it.
hint: Back row, third from the right. She'll want to hear it.

Name: OBJ_C5_05
title: Bring the freight lift online
description: All floors are card-locked, so enter the duty engineering override on the freight lift keypad.
hint: Facilities moved the code to the lift's own inspection sticker. You're standing next to it.

Name: OBJ_C5_06
title: Take component B from Genetics
description: Open the Genetics vault on floor 31 with the three-dial sequencer and take Antidote Component B from the cold drawer.
hint: Three letters, and they print them on every vial in the building.

Name: OBJ_C5_07
title: Get back to the lift
description: Cross the decontamination corridor without fighting the Brute patrolling it.
hint: The glass booths cycle on a timer. Stand in one and let him go by.

Name: OBJ_C5_08
title: Take component C from Cryo
description: Lift the cryo rack interlock on floor 33 and take Antidote Component C, then get out of the loading bay alive.
hint: The rack reads all three bays as one set, and somebody left them all different.

Name: OBJ_C5_09
title: Hear what he left for her
description: Play the recorded message looping in the cryo office Voss kept Dr. Calder's desk in.
hint: Her coat's still on the hook in there. So is the recorder.

Name: OBJ_C5_10
title: Reach the Crown Lab
description: Ride the freight lift to floor 35 and face Voss.
hint: He isn't hiding, Leon. He's been waiting up there all night.

Name: OBJ_C5_11
title: Take the roof access card
description: Pick the roof access card off Voss's desk, along with the letter underneath it.
hint: He left it out on purpose. He didn't want to break his own door.

Name: OBJ_C5_12
title: Synthesise the antidote
description: Load components A, B and C into the synthesis machine, enter the cold-shock sequence found in the Annex trial log, and run the cycle.
hint: All three ports, then the sequence from the Annex. Ninety seconds, and you hold the room.

Name: OBJ_C5_13
title: Survive Voss: the lab
description: Phase one. Open the glowing core when he lunges, and hit it.
hint: The chest only opens on the lunge. Make him commit, then put rounds in it.

Name: OBJ_C5_14
title: Survive Voss: the flood
description: Phase two. The water tanks burst. Use the standing water and the torn ceiling wiring to stun him.
hint: He's standing in it and you don't have to be. Drop the live cable while he's in the water.

Name: OBJ_C5_15
title: Finish it
description: Phase three. Voss is pinned under the fallen tank frame. Inject the antidote.
hint: Close enough to touch him. Hold the prompt and don't let go.

Name: OBJ_C5_16
title: Get to the roof plant room
description: Use the roof access card on the stair door above floor 35 and reach Voss's dosing manifold before 06:12.
hint: His card, his door, his timer. Nine minutes.

Name: OBJ_C5_17
title: Put the antidote in the water
description: Purge the dosing loop, shut the reservoir bypass, open the city main, and start the pump.
hint: Clear the line first or you send his batch out, not yours. Purge, bypass, main, pump.
